entries.title: Amos 1:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The time when Amos prophesied. 3 He shews God's judgment upon Syria, 6 upon the Philistines, 9 upon Tyrus, 11 upon Edom, 13 upon Ammon.

The words. Jer 1:1; 7:27 who. 7:14; Ex 3:1; 1Ki 19:19; Ps 78:70-72; Mt 4:18; 1Co 1:27 Tekoa. 2Sa 14:2; 2Ch 11:6; 20:20; Jer 6:1 he saw. Isa 1:1; Mic 1:1 in the. 2Ki 14:21; 15:1,2 Azariah. 2Ch 26:1-23; Ho 1:1; Mt 1:8,9 and in. 7:9-11; 2Ki 14:23-29 the earthquake. Zec 14:5

entries.title: Amos 1:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
break. Isa 43:14; Jer 50:36; 51:30; La 2:9; Na 3:13 the plain of Aven. or, Bikath-aven.Probably Heliopolis, now Baalbek, situated between Libanus and Antilibanus, 56 miles N. W. of Damascus, according to Antoninus, and celebrated for its temple of the sun.

the house of Eden. or, Beth-eden.Probably the village of Eden, in Mount Lebanon, marks the site of this place. It is delightfully situated by the side of a most rich and cultivated valley, contains about 400 or 500 families, and is, according to modern authorities, about 20 miles S. E. of Tripoli, and five miles from the cedars.

the people. 9:7; 2Ki 16:9
